scope: Independent static source/DDL observations; not execution or deployed-schema proof

wrapper.clientReference: optionalString trim/cap80 then current visible UUID or name resolution; resolved ID forwarded
effects: internal HTTP request with trusted tenant/actor
actor-scoped transaction and folder/client wall checks

budget.q: String(nullish fallback empty), first200 UTF16, no trimming
budget.projectId: String(nullish fallback empty), no producer truncation
budget.offset: max(0, Number(value) or0), then integer<=10000; no positive fraction truncation
budget.nextOffset: offset+100 only extra101st project; short returned page cannot continue

joins.projectTracking: LEFT JOIN exact tenant/owner/folder/kind budget/source project ID; folder equality has no coalesce. Tracking folder is NOT NULL; tuple UNIQUE. No-folder returns saved false/version null; saved false with version is possible for removed tracking.
joins.projectFilter: selected fiscal and optional exact ID/query; source collation title/id order is not JS lexical order
joins.documents: selected fiscal/session window, independent of project selector; explicit15 columns
joins.fullAmounts: optional project ID only, no fiscal/session join; id/observation; ordering timestamps omitted
joins.recentAmounts: per first100 project IDs, inner document session filter, not document fiscal filter; project_id/id/observation only; timing omitted
joins.events: event rows inner document join; selected fiscal/session and optional event.project_id; joined title/source_url/stage/fiscal_year; projected observed_at descending

opaqueJson: JSONB NOT NULL permits JSON null/scalars/arrays/objects; shared BudgetAmount is not a persistence constraint. No cross-query body equality, page-membership dependency, source completeness, currency conversion or stage aggregation is invented.
money: Exact decimal minor-unit strings in meaning-bearing observations must remain data without conversion; positions, percentages, blanks and stages are distinct. Arbitrary stored JSON is not certified as a BudgetAmount or awarded funds.
limits: Separate SQL reads and capped windows do not establish a shared immutable database snapshot
Raw text ID/URL/hash/date-like columns are not UUID/URL/hash/date format proofs
asOf binds wrapper generatedAt only as trusted asserted observation, not source query timing or freshness
Actual current authorization, service execution, provenance, schema deployment and source connectivity remain unqualified
